$comment: Body, alcohol and sweetness of grapes, read by hand from their Wikipedia articles where the model's reading left them empty (19 October 2026): each value with the sentence it comes from, copied as written, and the article's language. scripts/kb/build-grapes.ts checks every quote against that article as it checks a model's, and keeps only what the quote states. Sweetness is the range of the wines the grape makes: dry, medium (off-dry) or sweet, or a range such as dry-sweet. Origins too (20 October 2026): the country a grape comes from, read by hand only from a sentence that says so plainly — its name, its adjective or a region wholly within it — and never where the articles disagree or hedge.
